description: Header file defining configuration classes and structures for a plugin system, including JSON serialization, configuration options, and system paths.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Main configuration class containing nested classes for root configuration and system settings.

classes.name: Config::RootConfig
classes.description: Represents the root configuration with system locator, user, mode, and remote address settings.

classes.name: Config::RootObject
classes.description: Internal class for JSON serialization of the root config object.

classes.name: Config::Setting
classes.description: Helper class for logging configuration settings.

methods.name: Config::DataPath
methods.description: Constructs data path based on base path and class name.

methods.name: Config::PersistentPath
methods.description: Constructs persistent storage path based on base path and postfix or callsign.

methods.name: Config::VolatilePath
methods.description: Constructs volatile storage path based on base path and postfix or callsign.

methods.name: Config::IPV4UnicastNode
methods.description: Static method to get IPv4 unicast node for a given interface name.

methods.name: Config::IsSameInstance
methods.description: Checks if another Config instance refers to the same system instance.
